TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleRequest, logs it, and sends it to ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules. The library calls validatePostPricingRule to validate effectiveDate.startDate and effectiveDate.endDate with UtilDates.validateDates, check duplicate pricing rules from pricingRuleRequest.details, and resolve detail values with repository.fillDetailValues before writing data. 2. Decisions and branches: PricingRuleValidator.validatePost throws ABKO10000404 when endDate is before startDate. checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost returns without duplicate validation when details is null or empty; validateVariableCandidates returns when no variable candidates exist, throws ABKO10010401 for an exact-match candidate with the same fee, throws ABKO10010402 for an exact-match candidate with a different fee, and throws ABKO10010415 when a variable candidate shares payment method details; validateRegulatedCandidates returns when there are no variable payment methods or no regulated candidates and throws ABKO10010401 when a regulated candidate matches the input detail keys and fee; fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when no lookup query exists, no value is found, or NoResultException is raised for a detail id. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() obtains ABKOR001 through getServiceLibrary and calls executePostPricingRules(pricingRuleRequest). The library validates the request, reads the audit user from the request header, gets sequence ids for the audit log and pricing rule, inserts the audit row and pricing rule row, inserts one audit row and one detail row per detail, sets pricingRuleDTO.id to the generated pricing rule id, and returns the same DTO. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: executePostPricingRules catches PricingRuleException and adds the advice with the original code and description for ABKO10000404, ABKO10010401, ABKO10010402, ABKO10010415, and ABKO10010004 before returning null. Back in execute(), assignSeverityError sets severity EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() always calls setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) with the value returned by executePostPricingRules, even when that value is null after an error. When validation and persistence succeed, the response contains the same pricingRuleDTO with the generated id and the detail values filled in fillDetailValues.

Input Parameters.Description: Pricing rule payload used to validate duplicates, resolve detail values, and persist the new pricing rule.
Pricing rule name used to populate pricingRuleName in the pricing rule insert; when blank, getName() generates it from fee and details.
Fee data used to compare duplicate candidates and populate feeType and feeValue in the pricing rule insert.
Fee type used to compare candidate fees and populate the feeType column in the pricing rule insert.
Fee value used to compare candidate fees and populate the feeValue column in the pricing rule insert.
Effective date data used to validate the date range and populate startingDate and finishDate in the pricing rule insert.
Start date used in UtilDates.validateDates and mapped to startingDate in the pricing rule insert.
End date used in UtilDates.validateDates and mapped to finishDate in the pricing rule insert.
Detail list used to check duplicate pricing rules, resolve detail values, and insert pricing rule details.
Detail identifier used to compare existing details, resolve the detail value query, and populate objectEntityId in detail inserts.
Detail entity type used to sort and compare detail keys, select the value lookup query, and populate entityTypeId in detail inserts.
Precedence type used to populate precedenceType in the pricing rule insert, defaulting to CUSTOMIZE when null.
Progressive type used to populate progressiveType in the pricing rule insert, defaulting to UNIQUE when null.
Comments used to populate commentsDesc in the pricing rule insert.

Fee data returned in the response DTO after the library call succeeds.
List of pricing rule details returned after fillDetailValues resolves each detail value.
Mapped from jdbcUtils.queryForString(query, d.getId()) in fillDetailValues.
Returned from pricingRuleDTO.getPrecedenceType(), defaulting to CUSTOMIZE when null.
Returned from pricingRuleDTO.getProgressiveType(), defaulting to UNIQUE when null.
